notes.title: Update 20200605
notes.content:
-Fixed a crash that may occur when the source of card cannot be determined
-Fixed a crash related to files card
-Fixed clipper may prevent the system from shutdown
-When the main window is at the top, loading the card content will no longer hide the main window

notes.title: Now you can leave the Steam environment and run in background mode
notes.content:
Added a startup option:
(Background Mode) Launch Cliper Without Steam
Cliper will run independently of the steam environment if you start with this option
